main_text.p: fuerunt Emanuel Sà & Mariana in no-tis suis ad hunc locum aliquid tentare* Lyranus verò insignis inter Pontificios sic locum interpretatur: jejunarunt sep-tem diebus in signum trisitiæ propter mor-tem Saul & filiorum ejus. Permittat er-go mihi dominatio Harscheri illud ingeminare: Iabeschitas & Davidem je-junasse pro animis defunctorum ex purga-torio liberandis quâ scriptura probat Har-scherus?

p.i: Tobiæ. 4. Panem tuum & vi-num super sepulturam justi constitue & noli ex eo manducare & bibere cum pec-catoribus.

main_text.p: Belle sibi caverunt & religioni suæ Pontificii quòd non tantùm libros sa-cros πάσης ἀποδοχῆς ἀξίως obscuros, man-cos, imperfectos, & consequenter ar-ticulis fidei decidendis insufficientes: contra libros τῆς ἐπιστολῆς ἀξίως, iisdem confirmandis idoneos, verùm etiam, versionem latinam corruptissimam eo-dem

page.notes: Greek words in the two lines marked with the Greek phrases are as legible as the scan allows; the Greek accents are uncertain. The asterisk after "tentare" is a printed mark, copied as is. The catchword "dem" at the foot right is printed as a catchword.
